info.name: Qabz
info.description: HTTP API of the Qabz service (grpc-gateway). Kept up to date with every API change: docs/standards/PROJECT_SPECIFIC_CONVENTIONS.md section 7.

request.description: haf80.api.bill.Service/Greeting. Pings the service. Needs Authorization: Bearer {{token}} (collection auth), unless debug.auth.disable is true. Expected: HTTP 200 and {"message":"Hello"}; without a valid token HTTP 403.

header.description: Language of the list (raw value, as bill). Without the header: fa-IR.

request.description: haf80.api.bill.Service/Get. Returns the service list (bill types) of the Accept-Language language from the services table, by order, cached in memory for 60s. Needs Authorization: Bearer {{token}} (collection auth), unless debug.auth.disable is true. Expected: HTTP 200 and {"serviceId":<service.id>,"services":[{"name","isActive","tag","type","inquiry","icon"}]}; inquiry is the stored value (bill always sends true). Without a valid token HTTP 403; a database error HTTP 500.

exec: pm.test("has serviceId and a services list", function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("serviceId"); pm.expect(b.services).to.be.an("array"); });

request.description: haf80.api.bill.MyBills/GetAll. Returns the saved bills (My Bills) of the user of the JWT from the bills table: enabled rows only, newest first, with the bill mapping: tel/mobile give billId and phone = the stored phone (a second bill with the same phone is left out); gas gives billId and participateCode; operator and isPined come from json_data. Needs Authorization: Bearer {{token}} (collection auth), unless debug.auth.disable is true (then the user is debug.auth.mock_user_id; with that key empty HTTP 403). Expected: HTTP 200 and {"serviceId":<service.id>,"data":[{"id","name","type","lastOrderDate","billId","operator","isPined","phone","participateCode"}]}; a user with no bills gets "data":[]. Without a valid token HTTP 403; a database error HTTP 500.

exec: pm.test("has serviceId and a data list", function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("serviceId"); pm.expect(b.data).to.be.an("array"); });

request.description: haf80.api.bill.MyBills/Insert. Saves a bill (My Bills) for the user of the JWT in the bills table, with the bill rules: type gas, water, tel, mobile or electricity; water/electricity need a valid bill ID (check digit); gas needs a participateCode or a valid billId; mobile/tel need a phone (or the phone in billId), normalized to 98... An empty name gets the default name; mobile with no operator is saved as mci. A bill the user already has (same billId or inquiry ID) is not saved again: the answer has the existing id. Needs Authorization: Bearer {{token}} (collection auth), unless debug.auth.disable is true (then the user is debug.auth.mock_user_id; with that key empty HTTP 403). Expected: HTTP 200 and {"id","name","type","billId","operator","phone",...} echoing the request. An invalid request HTTP 400 "invalid parameter"; without a valid token HTTP 403; a database error HTTP 500.

variable.description: The id of a saved bill (the id that Insert or GetAll returns).

request.description: haf80.api.bill.MyBills/Delete. Deletes a saved bill (My Bills) of the user of the JWT, as bill does: the row stays with status disable, so GetAll no longer lists it. The id is checked with uuid.Parse of github.com/google/uuid (upper case, {...}, 32 hex digits and urn:uuid: are accepted) and goes to the database as sent. An unknown id, a bill of another user and a bill that is already disabled change nothing and still succeed. Needs Authorization: Bearer {{token}} (collection auth), unless debug.auth.disable is true (then the user is debug.auth.mock_user_id). Expected: HTTP 200 and {"message":"عملیات با موفقیت انجام شد"} (the operation was done successfully; bill sends its internal-error text on success, docs/this_vs_bill.md item 12). An id that does not parse, an empty id, a call with no user (debug.auth.disable with an empty mock_user_id) or a database error (also urn:uuid:..., which Postgres rejects): HTTP 500 {"code":2,"message":"خطای داخلی رخ داده است"} (gRPC Unknown, as bill). Without a valid token HTTP 403.

exec: pm.test("has the success message", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("عملیات با موفقیت انجام شد"); });

request.description: haf80.api.bill.Water/Inquiry. Inquires a water bill by billId (payId and participateCode are ignored, as in bill). The provider of (water, inquiry) is picked with ProvidersService; the saved inquiries of the same bill and provider that are younger than caching.water (default 1h; any user's rows count) answer with NO provider call, else the provider is called (Qabzino) and the answer is saved. With debug.mocks.qabzino.enable true (dev mode only) the Qabzino adapter answers a fixed answer: price 25000000, payId 2500012345, paymentDeadline 2030-01-01 (return_type success), or the provider-down error (return_type error). Needs Authorization: Bearer {{token}} (collection auth), unless debug.auth.disable is true (then the user is debug.auth.mock_user_id; with that key empty HTTP 403). Expected: HTTP 200 and {"price":<rials>,"paymentDeadline":"yyyy-mm-dd","payId":"...","billId":"..."} (a paid bill: price 0 and an empty payId). An invalid billId (6 to 13 digits with a valid check digit) HTTP 400 ("invalid parameter"); no valid token HTTP 403; no enabled provider, a failed provider call or a provider with no adapter HTTP 503 (message: the provider inquiry is temporarily disabled); a provider that has no inquiry for the bill HTTP 400 with the provider message; any other failure HTTP 500.

exec: pm.test("has price, payId, billId and paymentDeadline", function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("price"); pm.expect(b.price).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("payId"); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("billId"); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("paymentDeadline"); });

request.description: haf80.api.bill.Electricity/Inquiry. Inquires an electricity bill by billId (payId and participateCode are ignored, as in bill), with its details. The provider of (electricity, inquiry) is picked with ProvidersService; the saved inquiries of the same bill and provider that are younger than caching.electricity (default 1h; any user's rows count) answer with NO provider call and with the SAME details (saved in bill_inquiries.extra_data), else the provider is called (Tavanir) and the answer is saved. With debug.mocks.tavanir.enable true (dev mode only) the Tavanir adapter answers a fixed answer: price 18000000, payId 1800012345, paymentDeadline 2030-01-01, phase "تک فاز", companyName "توزیع برق تهران بزرگ", tariffType "خانگی", customerType "1", serialNumber 12345678, serviceAddress "تهران، خیابان آزادی، پلاک ۱", servicePostCode 1234567890, customerName "مشترک آزمایشی" (return_type success), or the provider-down error (return_type error). Needs Authorization: Bearer {{token}} (collection auth), unless debug.auth.disable is true (then the user is debug.auth.mock_user_id; with that key empty HTTP 403). Expected: HTTP 200 and {"payId":"...","billId":"...","price":<rials>,"paymentDeadline":"yyyy-mm-dd","phase":"...","companyName":"...","tariffType":"...","customerType":"<number as text>","serialNumber":"...","serviceAddress":"...","servicePostCode":"...","customerName":"..."} (a paid bill: price 0, an empty payId and empty details; an answer with no details: empty detail fields). An invalid billId (6 to 13 digits with a valid check digit) HTTP 400 ("invalid parameter"); no valid token HTTP 403; no enabled provider, a failed provider call or a provider with no adapter HTTP 503 (message: the provider inquiry is temporarily disabled); a provider that has no inquiry for the bill HTTP 400 with the provider message; any other failure HTTP 500. POST /v1/electricity/inquiry/document (InquiryDocument) is not implemented yet (HTTP 501).

exec: pm.test("has price, payId, billId and paymentDeadline", function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("price"); pm.expect(b.price).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("payId"); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("billId"); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("paymentDeadline"); });

pm.test("has the details", function () { const b = pm.response.json(); ["phase", "companyName", "tariffType", "customerType", "serialNumber", "serviceAddress", "servicePostCode", "customerName"].forEach(function (k) { pm.expect(b).to.have.property(k); pm.expect(b[k]).to.be.a("string"); }); });
